sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Troubadim is a physical-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (C), Defense (B).

sections.title: Is the Troubadim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (C), Defense (B). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
